finding: CPU srsUE DMRS estimator confuses frequency-selective channel response with noise; the resulting biased noise estimate attenuates MMSE-equalized constellation points and creates avoidable LDPC decoding iterations.
scope: Identified cause of the traced low-UE high-iteration bursts, not an accounting of all transport/scheduling stalls or the entire 8/16-UE scaling boundary.

configuration.ue: original CPU srsUE for IQ run; original objects relinked with one opt-in diagnostic wrapper for intervention pairs

evidence.implication: Captured CUDA channel output matches the declared channel plus declared AWGN in sampled windows.

evidence.test: Original-library estimator with exactly zero AWGN
evidence.inputs: Frozen channel frequency responses, FFT1536, 95 PRBs, DMRS type1 pilot positions
evidence.implication: Negative estimated SNR can be generated by the noiseless multipath response itself, independent of GPU load, ZMQ, and injected AWGN.

evidence.test: Intervention changes only the equalizer noise input
evidence.mutation: After original DMRS estimation returns, set chest_res->noise_estimate=0; leave q->csi/SNR reporting and other estimation results unchanged. Identical wrapped binary in both modes.
evidence.implication: The noise estimate affects actual equalization/decoding, not only the displayed SNR.

live_validation: All five runs, including boundary capture and four intervention runs, completed with live gates passed and 30/30 valid segments. Starvations remain nonzero.
limits: The zero-noise intervention is a diagnostic mutation, not a production fix. Correct repair needs a noise estimator that separates channel variation from actual noise.

Scheduling adapts to reception outcomes, so control/intervention payloads and MCS are not held equal. Speed differences are full live-stack outcomes; causal attribution relies on the isolated intervention plus IQ and noiseless-estimator evidence.
Native log-to-update matching excludes 10 ms around replay timestamps; it is a channel-window association, not a sample-exact PHY slot match.

Prior audit used uplink IQ progress to label a downlink event as update297. Uplink sample time is not a direct downlink-decoder slot identifier; current channel-window analysis replaces that association.
Other postwarm CRC failures remain in both intervention runs; this does not claim complete receiver correction.
repair_direction: Correct the CPU UE DMRS noise estimate and its use in equalization. No channel-emulator ZMQ wire-format change is required.
gpu_question: Faster LDPC can shorten the symptom, while moving the same biased estimation/equalization algorithm to GPU does not remove its cause. Existing GPU UE has a different CuPHY estimator path; no matched one-UE GPU result was established by these tests.
